entities.summary: Jacqueline Marie Zaba Nikiéma, a career diplomat, is the Ambassador from Burkina Faso to the Organisation of African, Caribbean and Pacific States (ACP). She was also the Special Representative of the President of the ECOWAS Commission in Guinea.
